name: sat_tube_guitar
description: Tube saturation for clean or lightly driven guitar — adds bite and harmonic presence
notes: Asymmetry 0.4, drive 0.15: subtle enough for clean amp tones, adds the kind of even-harmonic richness a tube preamp gives for free. 70% wet keeps the original attack intact. On distorted guitars this preset has minimal audible effect since the amp saturation already dominates — use sat_tape_subtle for distorted guitars instead.
